title: Encryption, from the ground up
intro: What actually happens in the S of HTTPS. From "anyone on the café Wi-Fi can read your packets" to keys, key exchange, hashes, signatures and certificates, one small block at a time, until TLS stops being magic.
how: Each puzzle starts with an attack the next block has to stop, gives you that one block, shows it in a diagram that plays itself, and ends with three questions you have to answer to unlock the next one. Facts come from the standards themselves (RFC 8446 for TLS 1.3, NIST's AES and SHA standards), quoted on every page.
heroAlt: Animated diagram: a letter from a phone passes a listener on the café Wi-Fi, who can read it until it's encrypted.

modules.title: Module 1: The blocks of HTTPS
modules.blurb: Six blocks, each stopping one attack, that together make TLS.
